scope: Original software voice selection/release, fresh-start software records and note-to-pitch conversion. Original routines execute with supplied owned MMIO storage and owned driver/tone state or unchanged local original tone bindings. Full note setup, SPU device synthesis, DMA, clock and audible scene playback remain unaccepted.
provided_original_inputs: Zero-initialized owned MMIO storage; original software initializer executes with requested voice count. Selection/release then receive owned full software records and pending key masks. Pitch uses supplied current-tone binding; owned table or unchanged original pitch table. No SPU device timing, DMA or synthesis.
limits: Pool selection does not set up or start a note. Mode-two immediate all-voice key-off is returned as a command for a future hardware backend.
Fresh-start software state assumes zero-initialized driver data. It does not emulate hardware initialization or reinitialization of an active driver.
Pitch table bounds errors are explicit port errors; out-of-range original memory access is not accepted.
The live queued backend still returns -1. Original voice setup, auto-volume, SPU synthesis and audible output remain required.
